scope: whole VI corpus (corpus/vi); see COVERAGE.md for the metric taxonomy

metrics.parseOk: VIs whose RSRC container parses / total VIs
metrics.decodeOk: VIs whose sections all inflate / total VIs
metrics.containerExact: VIs whose ViContainer round-trips byte-exactly / total VIs
metrics.blocksIdentified: block instances with a catalogued tag / all block instances
metrics.blockBytesDecoded: inflated block bytes in a block type with a decoder / all block bytes
metrics.deliberatelyParsed: heap body bytes inside a deliberately-framed record / heap body bytes
metrics.semanticallyDecoded: heap body bytes with a typed meaning / heap body bytes
metrics.valueKindKnown: heap body bytes with known value-kind but unknown meaning / heap body bytes
metrics.fullyParsedHeaps: heaps walked exactly to EOF / heaps
metrics.note: Each is 0..1; the VI format is fully understood IFF every axis is 1.0.
